name: Error

issues.reason: Reconcile “Verified” offering labels with unverified owner claims; explicitly attribute the doubled-testimonial promise.
Specify this buyer’s distinct evaluation, approval process, and validation questions; fragmented-proof needs overlap other segments.
Twelve minutes lacks credible allowance for conversations, activation support, and purchasing follow-through; scope or budget these separately.
Define evidence-gated weekly tasks and additional resource approvals; repeating the exhausted initial budget leaves later execution unspecified.
Set an observation window and minimum qualifying evidence count; distinguish purchasing interest from confirmed SaaS payment.
Specify a bounded access-repair test for silence and an observable threshold for changing approach.
Define how many reached buyers constitute consistent rejection and when to conclude the test.
Replace repeated generic learning language with a concise recording protocol covering replies, activation, buying steps, and payments.

message: The provider returned an incomplete or invalid report.
